title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to path traversal in the datasource functionality. (CVE-2026-84273)
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection version 12.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in its datasource functionality. This flaw allows an authenticated attacker to delete arbitrary files on the appliance, potentially impacting the integrity and availability of the system. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.1.
